m14.text: Lord Alcinore watches with his daughter Zaala as a squire armors them both before what she believes will be battle, and then reveals that their quest is to slay a dragon, a test of faith and bravery.

He tells Zaala that she will lead the survivors against the dragon seen near Telfer Peak, and they ride past villages burned to the earth to a scorched keep in Valkas, where a haggard band of fewer than thirty warriors greets them.
Afterward he praises Zaala for her victory.
